description: Check the U.S. EB-5 regional centers designated by USCIS: the current approved list and the list of terminated centers with termination dates and whether the termination is under appeal. Search by center name or ID, filter by state or status. Data comes from the official USCIS lists, which IMI Daily checks every six hours; uscis_as_of is the date USCIS gives for its list and last_checked is when IMI Daily last read it. Approval is a USCIS designation, not an endorsement of the center or its projects.

query.description: Regional center name or USCIS ID (e.g. 'RC2200000218' or 'ID1504052589')

state.description: U.S. state name or two-letter code, e.g. 'Texas' or 'TX'

name: find_eb5_regional_centers
title: EB-5 regional centers (USCIS)
